scripts.scan:leaks: bash -c 'while IFS= read -r p || [[ -n "$p" ]]; do [[ "$p" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue; [[ -z "$p" ]] && continue; if grep -rniI -- "$p" . --include="*.md" --include="*.mdx" --include="*.yaml" 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".leak-banlist.txt"; then echo "FOUND: $p"; fi; done < .leak-banlist.txt'
